label: Magic tree QR
desc: A QR code generator: paste a link and get a real, scannable code in leaf-coloured squares; tap it and it becomes an isometric 3D tree standing on a slab whose tiles are the code. Every link grows a different tree. Pick spring, summer, autumn or winter (falling petals, leaves or snow) or your own leaf and trunk colours, and download the code as PNG or SVG.
use: Share and invite pages, publishing links, the connect page, print and event materials.
